preconditions.description: n is an even integer between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(even_indices) == n // 2 and all(1 <= x <= 2 * 10**5 for x in even_indices)
preconditions.description: even_indices is a list of exactly n/2 positive integers, each between 1 and 2*10^5 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No' or (stdout.startswith('Yes') and len(recovered_sequence) == n and all(recovered_sequence[i] == even_indices[i//2] for i in range(1, n+1) if i % 2 == 0))
postconditions.description: If no valid sequence exists, output 'No'. Otherwise, output 'Yes' followed by a valid sequence of length n where even-indexed elements match the input.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('Yes') == any(all(is_square(sum(recovered_sequence[:t+1])) for t in range(n)) for recovered_sequence in possible_sequences)
postconditions.description: If a valid sequence exists, the output sequence must satisfy that every prefix sum (sum of first t elements) is a perfect square for all t from 1 to n.
